```{r modeling, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
# LEGO CASE STUDY: COMPLETE MODELING WORKFLOW
# Base R plots; seed 123 for reproducibility.
# LEGO recommended Price is NOT used as a predictor.

# 1. LOAD AND CLEAN DATA --------------------------------------------------

input_file <- file.choose()

x <- read.csv(
  input_file,
  fileEncoding = "windows-1252",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA")
)

x$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(x))

x$Amazon_Price <- as.numeric(
  gsub("[$, ]", "", x$Amazon_Price)
)

age_text <- gsub("\u00bd", ".5", x$Ages)
matched <- grepl("Ages_[0-9]+", age_text)

x$age <- NA_real_

x$age[matched] <- as.numeric(
  sub(
    ".*Ages_([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*",
    "\\1",
    age_text[matched],
    perl = TRUE
  )
)

d <- x[
  !is.na(x$Amazon_Price) & x$Amazon_Price > 0 &
    !is.na(x$Pieces) & x$Pieces > 0,
]

stopifnot(nrow(x) == 1304, nrow(d) == 826)

output_dir <- file.path(
  dirname(input_file),
  "LEGO_modeling_results"
)

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Original observations:", nrow(x), "\n")
cat("Observations after cleaning:", nrow(d), "\n")


# 2. TRAINING/TEST SPLIT AND CROSS-VALIDATION FOLDS ------------------------

set.seed(123)

train_rows <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(d)),
  size = floor(0.80 * nrow(d))
)

test_rows <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(d)), train_rows)

train <- d[train_rows, ]
test <- d[test_rows, ]

fold_id <- sample(
  rep(1:5, length.out = nrow(train))
)

cat("Training sets:", nrow(train), "\n")
cat("Test sets:", nrow(test), "\n")
print(table(fold_id))

model_names <- c(
  "Raw price: pieces",
  "Log price: log pieces",
  "Log price: structure",
  "Log price: theme",
  "Log price: theme + construction"
)


# 3. PREPROCESSING AND DESIGN MATRICES ------------------------------------

make_design <- function(a, b, model) {

  A <- matrix(
    1,
    nrow(a),
    1,
    dimnames = list(NULL, "Intercept")
  )

  B <- matrix(
    1,
    nrow(b),
    1,
    dimnames = list(NULL, "Intercept")
  )

  columns <- "Pieces"

  labels <- if (model == 1) {
    "pieces"
  } else {
    "log_pieces"
  }

  if (model >= 3) {
    columns <- c(columns, "Minifigures", "age")
    labels <- c(
      labels,
      "log1p_minifigures",
      "minimum_age"
    )
  }

  if (model == 5) {
    columns <- c(columns, "Pages", "Unique_Pieces")
    labels <- c(
      labels,
      "log_pages",
      "log_unique_pieces"
    )
  }

  for (j in seq_along(columns)) {

    col <- columns[j]
    aa <- a[[col]]
    bb <- b[[col]]

    if (model > 1 && col != "age") {
      aa <- if (col == "Minifigures") {
        log1p(aa)
      } else {
        log(aa)
      }

      bb <- if (col == "Minifigures") {
        log1p(bb)
      } else {
        log(bb)
      }
    }

    missing_a <- is.na(aa)
    missing_b <- is.na(bb)

    med <- median(aa, na.rm = TRUE)

    aa[missing_a] <- med
    bb[missing_b] <- med

    A <- cbind(A, aa)
    B <- cbind(B, bb)

    colnames(A)[ncol(A)] <- labels[j]
    colnames(B)[ncol(B)] <- labels[j]

    if (sum(missing_a) >= 5) {

      A <- cbind(A, as.numeric(missing_a))
      B <- cbind(B, as.numeric(missing_b))

      colnames(A)[ncol(A)] <- paste0(labels[j], "_missing")
      colnames(B)[ncol(B)] <- paste0(labels[j], "_missing")
    }
  }

  cats <- if (model >= 3) "Year" else character()

  if (model == 3) {
    cats <- c(cats, "Size")
  }

  if (model >= 4) {
    cats <- c(cats, "Theme")
  }

  for (col in cats) {

    aa <- enc2utf8(as.character(a[[col]]))
    bb <- enc2utf8(as.character(b[[col]]))

    aa[is.na(aa)] <- "Unknown"
    bb[is.na(bb)] <- "Unknown"

    if (col == "Theme") {

      counts <- table(aa)
      common <- names(counts[counts >= 15])

      aa[!aa %in% common] <- "Other"
      bb[!bb %in% common] <- "Other"
    }

    levels <- sort(unique(aa))

    if (length(levels) > 1) {

      for (lev in levels[-1]) {

        A <- cbind(A, as.numeric(aa == lev))
        B <- cbind(B, as.numeric(bb == lev))

        colnames(A)[ncol(A)] <- paste(col, lev, sep = "_")
        colnames(B)[ncol(B)] <- paste(col, lev, sep = "_")
      }
    }
  }

  list(A = A, B = B)
}


# 4. FIT MODELS AND GENERATE PREDICTIONS -------------------------------

fit_predict <- function(a, b, model) {

  design <- make_design(a, b, model)

  y <- if (model == 1) {
    a$Amazon_Price
  } else {
    log(a$Amazon_Price)
  }

  fit <- lm.fit(design$A, y)

  if (fit$rank < ncol(design$A)) {
    stop("Rank-deficient design: inspect predictors.")
  }

  smearing <- if (model == 1) {
    1
  } else {
    mean(exp(fit$residuals))
  }

  prediction <- drop(
    design$B %*% fit$coefficients
  )

  if (model > 1) {
    prediction <- exp(prediction) * smearing
  }

  list(
    prediction = prediction,
    fit = fit,
    A = design$A,
    B = design$B,
    y = y,
    smearing = smearing
  )
}

rmse <- function(y, p) {
  sqrt(mean((y - p)^2))
}

mae <- function(y, p) {
  mean(abs(y - p))
}


# 5. FIVE-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION -------------------------------------------

comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c(model_names, "Baseline: training mean"),
  CV_RMSE = NA_real_,
  CV_MAE = NA_real_
)

for (model in 1:5) {

  predictions <- numeric(nrow(train))

  for (fold in 1:5) {

    validation <- fold_id == fold

    predictions[validation] <- fit_predict(
      train[!validation, ],
      train[validation, ],
      model
    )$prediction
  }

  comparison$CV_RMSE[model] <- rmse(
    train$Amazon_Price,
    predictions
  )

  comparison$CV_MAE[model] <- mae(
    train$Amazon_Price,
    predictions
  )
}

baseline_predictions <- numeric(nrow(train))

for (fold in 1:5) {

  validation <- fold_id == fold

  fold_mean <- mean(
    train$Amazon_Price[!validation]
  )

  baseline_predictions[validation] <- fold_mean
}

comparison$CV_RMSE[6] <- rmse(
  train$Amazon_Price,
  baseline_predictions
)

comparison$CV_MAE[6] <- mae(
  train$Amazon_Price,
  baseline_predictions
)

print(comparison, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  comparison,
  file.path(output_dir, "model_comparison.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

selected <- which.min(comparison$CV_RMSE[1:5])

cat("\nSelected model:", model_names[selected], "\n")


# 6. HELD-OUT TEST EVALUATION ---------------------------------------------

result <- fit_predict(train, test, selected)
pred <- result$prediction

test_baseline <- rep(
  mean(train$Amazon_Price),
  nrow(test)
)

test_r_squared <- 1 -
  sum((test$Amazon_Price - pred)^2) /
  sum((test$Amazon_Price - mean(test$Amazon_Price))^2)

metrics <- data.frame(
  Measure = c(
    "Test RMSE: selected model",
    "Test MAE: selected model",
    "Test R-squared: selected model",
    "Test RMSE: mean baseline",
    "Test MAE: mean baseline",
    "Smearing factor"
  ),
  Value = c(
    rmse(test$Amazon_Price, pred),
    mae(test$Amazon_Price, pred),
    test_r_squared,
    rmse(test$Amazon_Price, test_baseline),
    mae(test$Amazon_Price, test_baseline),
    result$smearing
  )
)

print(metrics, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  metrics,
  file.path(output_dir, "test_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

held_out <- data.frame(
  Item_Number = test$Item_Number,
  Set_Name = test$Set_Name,
  Observed = test$Amazon_Price,
  Predicted = pred,
  Error = pred - test$Amazon_Price
)

write.csv(
  held_out,
  file.path(output_dir, "held_out_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nFive largest absolute prediction errors:\n")

print(
  head(
    held_out[order(abs(held_out$Error), decreasing = TRUE), ],
    5
  )
)


# 7. HC3 ROBUST COEFFICIENT INTERVALS -------------------------------------

A <- result$A
e <- result$fit$residuals

n <- nrow(A)
p <- ncol(A)

bread <- solve(crossprod(A))
h <- rowSums((A %*% bread) * A)

V_HC3 <- bread %*%
  crossprod(
    A,
    A * as.numeric((e / (1 - h))^2)
  ) %*%
  bread

se <- sqrt(diag(V_HC3))
beta <- result$fit$coefficients

critical <- qt(0.975, df = n - p)

coefficients <- data.frame(
  Term = colnames(A),
  Estimate = beta,
  HC3_SE = se,
  CI_low = beta - critical * se,
  CI_high = beta + critical * se,
  p_value = 2 * pt(
    abs(beta / se),
    df = n - p,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )
)

print(coefficients, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  coefficients,
  file.path(output_dir, "coefficients.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# 8. DIAGNOSTICS AND INFLUENCE --------------------------------------------

aux <- lm.fit(A, e^2)

aux_r2 <- 1 -
  sum(aux$residuals^2) /
  sum((e^2 - mean(e^2))^2)

bp_stat <- n * aux_r2

cat(
  "\nBreusch-Pagan-style test p-value:",
  pchisq(bp_stat, p - 1, lower.tail = FALSE),
  "\n"
)

mse <- sum(e^2) / (n - p)

cooks <- e^2 / (p * mse) * h / (1 - h)^2

largest <- which.max(cooks)

cat("Largest Cook distance:", max(cooks), "\n")
cat("Set:", train$Set_Name[largest], "\n")

sensitivity <- fit_predict(
  train[-largest, ],
  test,
  selected
)

cat(
  "Test RMSE excluding the most influential training observation:",
  rmse(test$Amazon_Price, sensitivity$prediction),
  "\n"
)


# 9. REGRESSION PLOTS -----------------------------------------------------
# Use normal-sized margins; no oversized fixed margins.

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1) + 0.1)

barplot(
  rev(comparison$CV_RMSE),
  names.arg = rev(comparison$Model),
  horiz = TRUE,
  las = 1,
  cex.names = 0.75,
  col = "white",
  border = "black",
  xlab = "Cross-validation RMSE ($)",
  main = "Cross-Validation RMSE"
)

par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1) + 0.1)

limits <- range(
  c(0, test$Amazon_Price, pred, test_baseline),
  finite = TRUE
)

plot(
  test$Amazon_Price,
  pred,
  pch = 1,
  xlim = limits,
  ylim = limits,
  xlab = "Observed Amazon price ($)",
  ylab = "Predicted Amazon price ($)",
  main = "Held-Out Predictions"
)

abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1) + 0.1)

plot(
  result$fit$fitted.values,
  e,
  pch = 1,
  xlab = "Fitted value",
  ylab = "Residual",
  main = "Training Residuals"
)

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1) + 0.1)

qqnorm(
  e,
  pch = 1,
  main = "Normal Q-Q Plot"
)

qqline(e, col = "black")

par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1) + 0.1)

plot(
  cooks,
  type = "h",
  xlab = "Training observation",
  ylab = "Cook's distance",
  main = "Influence Diagnostics"
)

abline(h = 4 / n, lty = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)


# 10. REPRODUCIBILITY DETAILS ---------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  data.frame(row_id = train$row_id, fold = fold_id),
  file.path(output_dir, "training_split.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(row_id = test$row_id),
  file.path(output_dir, "test_split.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

capture.output(
  sessionInfo(),
  file = file.path(output_dir, "R_session_info.txt")
)

cat("\nAll results saved in:", output_dir, "\n")
```

```{r additional-model-plots, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ADDITIONAL MODEL COMPARISON PLOTS
# Requires all_cv_results, test_comparison,
# lasso_test_pred, rf_test_pred, lasso_table, and rf_importance.

# 11. CROSS-VALIDATION RMSE -----------------------------------------------

barplot(
  rev(all_cv_results$CV_RMSE),
  names.arg = rev(all_cv_results$Model),
  horiz = TRUE,
  las = 1,
  cex.names = 0.7,
  col = "white",
  border = "black",
  xlab = "Five-fold CV RMSE ($)",
  main = "Cross-Validation RMSE by Model"
)


# 12. CROSS-VALIDATION MAE -------------------------------------------------

barplot(
  rev(all_cv_results$CV_MAE),
  names.arg = rev(all_cv_results$Model),
  horiz = TRUE,
  las = 1,
  cex.names = 0.7,
  col = "white",
  border = "black",
  xlab = "Five-fold CV MAE ($)",
  main = "Cross-Validation MAE by Model"
)


# 13. HELD-OUT TEST RMSE AND MAE ------------------------------------------

test_errors <- rbind(
  RMSE = test_comparison$Test_RMSE,
  MAE = test_comparison$Test_MAE
)

colnames(test_errors) <- test_comparison$Model

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 8, 3, 1) + 0.1)
barplot(
  test_errors,
  beside = TRUE,
  horiz = TRUE,
  las = 1,
  cex.names = 0.7,
  col = c("white", "gray70"),
  border = "black",
  xlab = "Prediction error ($)",
  main = "Held-Out Test Prediction Errors",
  legend.text = rownames(test_errors),
  args.legend = list(
    x = "bottomright",
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.75
  )
)


# 14. OBSERVED VS. PREDICTED PRICES ---------------------------------------

prediction_sets <- list(
  "Selected Regression" = pred,
  "LASSO" = lasso_test_pred,
  "Random Forest" = rf_test_pred
)

observed <- test$Amazon_Price

plot_limits <- range(
  c(observed, unlist(prediction_sets)),
  finite = TRUE
)

for (model in names(prediction_sets)) {

  plot(
    observed,
    prediction_sets[[model]],
    pch = 19,
    col = "gray40",
    xlim = plot_limits,
    ylim = plot_limits,
    xlab = "Observed price ($)",
    ylab = "Predicted price ($)",
    main = model
  )

  abline(0, 1, lty = 2)
}


# 15. LASSO COEFFICIENTS ---------------------------------------------------

lasso_plot_data <- lasso_table[
  lasso_table$Predictor != "(Intercept)",
]

if (nrow(lasso_plot_data) > 0) {

  lasso_plot_data <- lasso_plot_data[
    order(lasso_plot_data$Coefficient),
  ]
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 7, 3, 1) + 0.1)

  barplot(
    lasso_plot_data$Coefficient,
    names.arg = lasso_plot_data$Predictor,
    horiz = TRUE,
    las = 1,
    cex.names = 0.6,
    col = "white",
    border = "black",
    xlab = "Coefficient on log-price scale",
    main = "LASSO: Retained Coefficients"
  )

} else {

  cat("LASSO retained no nonzero predictor coefficients.\n")
}


# 16. RANDOM FOREST VARIABLE IMPORTANCE -----------------------------------

importance_column <- if ("%IncMSE" %in% names(rf_importance)) {
  "%IncMSE"
} else {
  "IncNodePurity"
}

importance_plot_data <- head(rf_importance, 15)

importance_plot_data <- importance_plot_data[
  order(importance_plot_data[[importance_column]]),
]

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 8, 3, 1) + 0.1)

barplot(
  importance_plot_data[[importance_column]],
  names.arg = importance_plot_data$Predictor,
  horiz = TRUE,
  las = 1,
  cex.names = 0.65,
  col = "white",
  border = "black",
  xlab = importance_column,
  main = "Random Forest Variable Importance"
)
```

```{r}

# Add to the END of the additional-model-plots chunk, after the plot commands.
# Requires the LASSO/random-forest fitting code to have run first.
models <- c("LASSO", "Random Forest")
cv_table <- all_cv_results[
  match(models, all_cv_results$Model),
  c("Model", "CV_RMSE", "CV_MAE")
]
test_table <- test_comparison[
  match(models, test_comparison$Model),
  c("Test_RMSE", "Test_MAE")
]

observed <- test$Amazon_Price
test_r2 <- function(predicted) {
  1 - sum((observed - predicted)^2) /
    sum((observed - mean(observed))^2)
}

model_metrics <- cbind(
  cv_table,
  test_table,
  Test_R2 = c(test_r2(lasso_test_pred), test_r2(rf_test_pred))
)
row.names(model_metrics) <- NULL
model_metrics[-1] <- lapply(model_metrics[-1], round, digits = 3)

cat("\nLASSO and random forest numerical results:\n")
print(model_metrics, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  model_metrics,
  file.path(output_dir, "lasso_random_forest_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
